atAGlance: Nước nha đam is aloe vera drink, lightly sweet with slippery aloe cubes that make texture part of the refreshment.
whatItIs: Nước nha đam is sweet aloe drink served cold. Expect aloe vera drink with sweet liquid and slippery, cooling aloe cubes.
howToEnjoy: Sip slowly so you get the chewy aloe pieces, not just the sweet drink.
howLocalsOrder: Nước nha đam is ordered for the slippery aloe pieces as much as the sweet drink. Ask for less sugar and no ice if you want the aloe texture to stay noticeable.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước nha đam shows Vietnam’s love of drinks with texture, where the chew can be as important as the flavor.
goodToKnow: The aloe texture is slippery and soft.
